name: Life of the Prophet
description: The life story of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him)

questions.question: In which city was Prophet Muhammad born?
questions.explanation: Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was born in Mecca.

questions.question: What was the name of the Prophet's mother?
questions.explanation: The Prophet's mother was Aminah bint Wahb.

questions.question: What was the name of the Prophet's father?
questions.explanation: His father was Abdullah, who passed away before the Prophet was born.

questions.question: What nickname did the people of Mecca give young Muhammad for his honesty?
questions.explanation: He was called Al-Amin, meaning 'the Trustworthy', because he never lied.

questions.question: Who was the first person to believe in the Prophet's message?
questions.explanation: His wife Khadijah was the first person to accept Islam.

questions.question: Which angel brought the revelation to Prophet Muhammad?
questions.explanation: Angel Jibril (Gabriel) brought Allah's words to the Prophet.

questions.question: How did the Prophet treat children?
questions.explanation: The Prophet was gentle and loving with children, greeting them and playing with them.

questions.question: What did the Prophet teach about telling the truth?
questions.explanation: The Prophet taught that truthfulness leads to goodness and Paradise.

questions.question: To which city did the Prophet migrate with the Muslims?
questions.explanation: The Prophet and the Muslims migrated to Medina. This is called the Hijrah.

questions.question: How did the Prophet treat animals?
questions.explanation: The Prophet taught Muslims to be merciful to animals and never harm them.

questions.question: What was the job of Prophet Muhammad as a young man?
questions.explanation: As a young man he looked after sheep and later became an honest merchant.

questions.question: Who was the Prophet's beloved daughter, married to Ali?
questions.explanation: Fatimah (may Allah be pleased with her) was the Prophet's daughter who married Ali.

questions.question: In which year was Prophet Muhammad born?
questions.explanation: He was born in the Year of the Elephant, around 570 CE.

questions.question: Who was the Prophet's grandfather who cared for him?
questions.explanation: His grandfather Abdul-Muttalib cared for him after his mother passed away.

questions.question: Which uncle raised the Prophet after his grandfather passed away?
questions.explanation: His uncle Abu Talib raised him and protected him for many years.

questions.question: Who was the wet nurse who cared for baby Muhammad in the desert?
questions.explanation: Halimah as-Sa'diyyah nursed him as a baby, as was the custom in Mecca.

questions.question: How old was the Prophet when he received the first revelation?
questions.explanation: He was 40 years old when Angel Jibril came to him in Cave Hira.

questions.question: In which cave did the Prophet like to think quietly before becoming a Prophet?
questions.explanation: He would go to Cave Hira on the Mountain of Light (Jabal an-Nur) to reflect.

questions.question: How old was the Prophet when he married Khadijah?
questions.explanation: He was 25 years old when he married Khadijah, who admired his honesty.

questions.question: What was the 'Year of Sorrow'?
options: The year of a big flood
The year the Prophet was born
The year of the first battle
The year Khadijah and Abu Talib passed away
questions.explanation: In one sad year, the Prophet lost both his wife Khadijah and his uncle Abu Talib.

questions.question: Who traveled with the Prophet during the Hijrah to Medina?
questions.explanation: His close friend Abu Bakr accompanied him on the journey to Medina.

questions.question: Who slept in the Prophet's bed on the night of the Hijrah to keep him safe?
questions.explanation: Young Ali bravely slept in the Prophet's bed so the Quraysh would not know he had left.

questions.question: What did the Prophet build first when he arrived in Medina?
questions.explanation: The first thing built was the mosque, Masjid an-Nabawi, the center of the community.

questions.question: What animal did the Prophet ride into Medina?
questions.explanation: He arrived on his camel, Qaswa, and let her choose where to stop — that spot became the mosque.

questions.question: What agreement did the Prophet make between the Muhajirun and the Ansar in Medina?
questions.explanation: The Prophet paired each migrant (Muhajir) with a helper (Ansari) as brothers who shared what they had.

questions.question: What was the treaty the Prophet signed with the Quraysh at Hudaybiyyah?
questions.explanation: The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah was a peace agreement that later opened the way for Islam to spread.

questions.question: What did the Prophet do to the people of Mecca when he entered the city victorious?
questions.explanation: The Prophet forgave the people of Mecca, saying 'Go, for you are free.'

questions.question: How many times is Prophet Muhammad mentioned by the name 'Muhammad' in the Quran?
questions.explanation: The name Muhammad appears 4 times in the Quran; he is also called Ahmad once.

questions.question: Which son of the Prophet passed away as a baby in Medina?
questions.explanation: His son Ibrahim passed away as a baby, and the Prophet was very sad but patient.

questions.question: Where did the Prophet give his Farewell Sermon?
questions.explanation: During his final Hajj, the Prophet gave the Farewell Sermon at Arafah.

questions.question: How old was the Prophet when he passed away?
questions.explanation: The Prophet passed away at 63 years old in Medina.

questions.question: In whose room was the Prophet buried?
questions.explanation: He was buried in the room of his wife Aisha, where he passed away.

questions.question: What was the name of the Prophet's adopted son, mentioned in the Quran?
questions.explanation: Zayd ibn Harithah is the only companion mentioned by name in the Quran.

questions.question: What miracle happened on the night of Isra and Mi'raj?
options: The Prophet traveled to Jerusalem and the heavens in one night
questions.explanation: Allah took His Messenger from Mecca to Jerusalem and up through the heavens in a single night.

questions.question: What did the Prophet say about a Muslim's neighbor?
questions.explanation: The Prophet taught so much kindness to neighbors that companions thought neighbors might inherit.

questions.question: Which title describes the Prophet as a mercy to all creation?
questions.explanation: The Quran describes the Prophet as Rahmatan lil-'Alamin — a mercy to all the worlds.
